SELECT m.tenant_id,m.province_id,m.alarm_time, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.town_id, 0 AS yesterday_all, sum( m.today_all ) AS today_all, sum( m.false_all ) AS false_all, sum(m.today_process) AS today_process, sum(m.today_complete) AS today_complete, 0 AS pendding_receive, 0 AS pendding_judged, 0 AS pending_dispatched, 0 AS pedding_disposal, 0 AS pending_approve, 0 AS pendding_Leader_approve, sum(m.overtime) AS overtime FROM ( SELECT a.tenant_id,a.alarm_time, a.province_code AS province_id, a.city_code AS city_id,a.county_code AS county_id,a.town_code AS town_id,a.device_code, IF (DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( NOW( ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), 1, 0 ) AS yesterday_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate}, 1, 0 ) AS today_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.judge_result = '0', 1, 0 ) AS false_all, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND ((a.order_status IN ( '1', '2', '3', '4', '5' )AND a.enable_acceptance_mode !='1')OR a.enable_acceptance_mode = '1'), 1, 0 ) AS today_process, IF ( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND a.order_status IN ('6','0','7'), 1, 0 ) AS today_complete, IF( DATE_FORMAT( a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m' ) = #{handleDate} AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.flow_node_time, NOW()) > a.time_limit AND a.time_limit IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS overtime FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' ) m GROUP BY m.tenant_id,m.province_id, m.city_id, m.county_id,m.town_id,DATE_FORMAT( m.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d' )
